items.title: Government & Public Sector
items.text: National PKI, citizen identity, digital public services and trusted records for ministries and provinces.

items.text: Bank CAs, onboarding, authentication, open APIs and payment security for regulated institutions.

items.title: Trust Service Providers & CAs
items.text: Everything a CA or qualified trust service provider runs: CA, RA, VA, TSA, remote signing, HSMs and audit readiness.

items.title: Telecommunications
items.text: Mobile PKI, remote signing for subscribers, SIM-swap protection and SOC for network operators.

items.title: Enterprise
items.text: Zero-trust access, secure browsing, signing, e-contracts and security operations for large organisations.

items.title: Energy & Utilities
items.text: Power, water and gas operators: secure smart meters and OT networks, zero-trust access and quantum-safe links for critical infrastructure.

items.title: Automotive & Mobility
items.text: Connected vehicles and EV charging: digital car keys, vehicle PKI, secure over-the-air updates and crypto agility.

items.title: Transport & Logistics
items.text: Airports, ports, transit and logistics: identity at checkpoints, AI cameras, e-documents and contactless payment.

items.title: Retail & eCommerce
items.text: Fraud-resistant checkout, wallets, customer data and biometric payment for merchants and marketplaces.

items.title: Education
items.text: Universities and schools: student identity, digital diplomas, campus access and payments, and secure records.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Signed medical records, protected patient data and secure staff access.

items.title: Media & Broadcasting
items.text: AI-native newsrooms, production planning and broadcast platforms.
